data.long_meaning: Shubhank is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shubh', meaning auspicious or prosperous. It is often given to children to bring good fortune and success. Parents who choose Shubhank usually hope their child will grow to embody auspicious, prosperous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
